name: CPU Sparse Voxel Octree Traversal
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for a 3D sparse voxel octree stored in a linear block structure, implemented on the CPU. It uses a stack to manage traversal state, handling valid internal nodes, leaf nodes, and empty space by casting rays to the next occupied voxel.
summary: CPU Sparse Voxel Octree Traversal is a ray traversal algorithm for 3D sparse voxel octrees that uses explicit stack management and discrete slab boundaries, distinguishing it from GPU-based parametric approaches.
